timelineItems.title: Sent revised proposal — v3 with CFO discount
timelineItems.preview: Attached updated pricing sheet with 15% annual-prepay discount and revised SLA terms.
timelineItems.notes: Proposal included 3 pricing tiers. CFO had asked for annual prepay option in the Apr 17 meeting. Followed up with security questionnaire attachment.

timelineItems.title: Discovery call — Marcus Chen (CTO)
timelineItems.preview: Confirmed SSO is table-stakes. Flagged concern about SAML provider compatibility.
timelineItems.notes: Marcus confirmed SSO via SAML is a hard requirement. Their current IdP is Okta. He flagged a past bad experience with Dynamics 365 migration. Open to a technical deep-dive call with our SA team.

timelineItems.title: Executive alignment — Sarah Bloom (CFO)
timelineItems.preview: CFO requested annual-prepay option. Positive on value; wants legal to review DPA.
timelineItems.notes: CFO was receptive to pricing. Requested we add an annual-prepay discount tier. She confirmed budget is approved contingent on legal sign-off. DPA sent same day.

timelineItems.title: Sent security questionnaire response
timelineItems.preview: Completed InfoSec questionnaire attached. SOC 2 Type II report available on request.
timelineItems.notes: Completed all 47 questions in their vendor security questionnaire. Highlighted our SOC 2 Type II, GDPR compliance, and 99.99% uptime SLA. No reply received yet.

timelineItems.title: Internal note — competitive intel update
timelineItems.preview: Buyer mentioned Salesforce pitched last week. Key objection: implementation timeline.
timelineItems.notes: Per a conversation with the economic buyer's assistant, Salesforce pitched on Apr 9. Key concern raised: 6-month implementation. Our 2-4 week timeline is a strong differentiator. Need to reinforce in next touchpoint.
